name: Soybean
notes: Flowering triggered by shortening days; maturity group drives window.
sourceNote: Agronomic literature (USDA plant physiology); varies by cultivar.

name: Rice
notes: Many varieties flower when days shorten toward 12-13h.
sourceNote: IRRI photoperiod notes; varies by subspecies.

name: Corn (Maize)
notes: Day-neutral; temperature and moisture set the clock.

name: Spring Wheat
notes: Long days accelerate heading; vernalization not required for spring types.

name: Onion (Bulbing)
notes: Bulbing induced once day length passes a cultivar-specific threshold (short-day ~11-12h, long-day ~15-16h).

name: Tomato
notes: Day-neutral; fruit set gated by temperature.

name: Potato
notes: Tuberization varies with day length by cultivar.

name: Hemp / Cannabis
notes: Flowering unlocks when day length drops to ~12h.
